method.benchmark: QQQ/TQQQ TREND200 use own ETF SMA200. Extra TQQQ reference is not a sixth optimized model.
method.costs: 2 or10bp roundtrip notional; half per leg; cash interest0; taxes and brokerFXfees excluded
method.currency: USD reference plus EUR cash using prior-date ECB at open, latest published ECB at close; FX quotes/fees not observed
method.deposits: 100 after first cash-session open of each subsequent month; deploy next open; no backdating
method.distributions: Split-adjusted prices; real dividend accrual once on ex-date; economic NAV, not settled payment cash
method.rebalance: Monthly paid reweighting plus existing daily sleeve cap trims and regime changes;1percent/min10 reserve
method.risk: Allocation state-machine study; daily NAV, not intraday DD; no new account circuit-breaker or reset policy

s1.rule: State2 + S1; TQQQ16:01 -> next09:31; stop0.50 priorATR; max0.5percentNAV risk
